title: Prompt Studio
tagline: A Chrome extension for prompt engineering with version control
description: A developer tool extension that provides a structured environment for writing, testing, versioning, and collaborating on LLM prompts.

slides.title: The Problem
slides.content: Prompt engineering happens in scattered text files, browser tabs, and chat history. There's no version control, no structured testing, and no way to collaborate on prompts with teams.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.content: As LLMs become critical infrastructure, prompt quality directly impacts product quality. Treating prompts as code — with versioning, testing, and review — is essential for reliable AI applications.

slides.title: The Solution
slides.content: A Chrome extension that adds a side panel for prompt editing with built-in version history (using IndexedDB), A/B testing of prompt variants, and one-click export to Python/TypeScript SDKs.

slides.title: Technical Architecture
slides.content: Built with Manifest V3, the extension uses a service worker for background tasks, IndexedDB for local storage with CRDT-based sync, and a Content Script that injects into common LLM chat UIs. The React popup communicates via Chrome runtime messaging.

slides.title: Results & Impact
slides.content: 10K+ installs, 4.6 star rating, adopted by 3 enterprise teams for internal prompt management. Featured in Chrome Web Store's AI tools collection.

slides.title: Learnings
slides.content: IndexedDB performance degrades with large prompt histories — would migrate to OPFS (Origin Private File System). Collaborative editing via CRDT was over-engineered for single-user scenarios; simpler git-like snapshots would suffice.
